text:
Lina: Dropping a new mock for the batch vectors export + relevance table tweaks: https://www.figma.com/file/newvectors. Two asks: (1) sanity-check copy for non-ML folks, (2) quick accessibility + keyboard pass. Short thread please.

Mark: Nice layout. One copy nit: change the export button to `Export vectors (.csv / .jsonl)` — give users the JSONL option for downstream consumers. Also show an estimated download size and an option to gzip on the server.

Zoe: A11y: modal should be a true dialog (role="dialog" aria-modal="true"). Add focus trap and return focus to the trigger on close. Announce export type selection with aria-live when changed.

Carlos: Backend constraints: JSONL + gzip is good. For >3k rows we'll queue an async job. We can support previews (first 200 rows) client-side. Also recommend a soft cap warning at 25k rows and require explicit confirmation for >100k.

Lina: For copy: the export modal headline currently reads "Export" 1 let's change to "Export vectors and metadata" and the secondary copy: "Choose file type and columns. Large exports may be prepared in the background."

Mark: UI tweak: add a small dropdown labeled "Preset" with options: "Compact", "Full metadata", "Rerank-ready". Selecting a preset toggles checkboxes for columns (e.g., include_vector_length, include_source). Show short helper text under the dropdown that updates based on selection.

Zoe: Keyboard specifics: when table is in focus, Home/End should go to first/last cell in the row. Arrow keys move between cells. Space/Enter toggles a column checkbox. Provide visible focus rings for all interactive elements.

Carlos: For exports include these columns by default for Full: `vector_uuid,text_snippet,relevance_pct,vector_length,source_uri,original_id,created_iso`. Use snake_case for CSV headers to be script-friendly.

Lina: Quick sample header for discussion:

```
vector_uuid,text_snippet,relevance_pct,vector_length,source_uri,original_id,created_iso
```

Can we also include an optional `rank_delta` field for rerank experiments?

Mark: `rank_delta` is useful. Make it optional since it requires post-processing. Also in the preview table show both `relevance_pct` and a small inline sparkline showing local score distribution for that row across candidates (tiny 20px sparkline). That sparkline should be decorative (aria-hidden) with text alternative like "score distribution" available via tooltip.

Zoe: For screen readers: mark sparklines `aria-hidden=true` and add a visually-hidden tooltip text tied to the cell `aria-describedby` that says "Score distribution available". Also ensure the export progress area uses `<div role="status" aria-live="polite">` to announce state changes.

Carlos: Implementation note: server-side sort + filters for full dataset; preview sorts client-side. For export estimates we can calculate approximate CSV size from sampling. We'll show a progress percent and a link in the UI when ready.

Lina: UX microcopy: change empty preview messaging from "No data" to "Upload or map a CSV to preview vectors". For the mapping step show examples: "Column A -> Text (context)" with a ? help link.

Mark: Add an export confirmation for >25k rows that lists estimated size and time: e.g., "~120MB gzipped, ~3 minutes to prepare." Allow users to choose in-UI notification vs email.

Zoe: Accessibility quick checklist requests: focus management, aria-live for job updates, keyboard support for presets and mapping chips, visible focus for the sample size selector, and color-contrast checks for the inline sparkline colors. I'll run a short pass after Figma updates are pushed.

Lina: Decision summary: 1) Change CTA to `Export vectors (.csv / .jsonl)` + gzip option. 2) Add Preset dropdown (Compact / Full metadata / Rerank-ready). 3) CSV headers use snake_case; include optional `rank_delta`. 4) Async export for >3k; confirmation for >25k and block/extra confirm for >100k. 5) A11y: modal role/aria-modal, focus trap, aria-live/role=status for progress, sparklines aria-hidden with descriptions. 6) Keyboard: Home/End, arrow keys, Enter/Space toggles, Tab order preservation.

Carlos: I'll spec the async job behavior and size estimates. ETA: two sprints.

Mark: I'll prototype the gzip toggle + size estimator in the mock.

Zoe: I'll prepare the accessibility notes and a small test plan.

accessibility-bot: Added quick comments on Figma frames and created ticket #A11Y-912 for the modal focus/aria updates.

Lina: Thanks all :rocket: I'll update Figma and follow up with the tickets and a small demo for the Friday sync.
